name: sca-exempt
tagline: A PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication exemption engine that says when SCA can be skipped, and why.
trendOrigin: open-banking-tracker-data (the open banking API directory). The directory itself is a list; the signal is that everyone building against PSD2/open-banking APIs must implement the same SCA exemption logic and it is notoriously easy to get the counter resets and thresholds wrong.
